name: AxisCrossKit
description: Cross-test library: crossUp/crossDown/crossDir helpers + BULL/BEAR marker colors and a CrossDir enum. Publish it (Library panel -> Publish library) to unlock the Kit Consumer indicator.
content:
//@version=6
// @description Cross-detection kit for the AXIS cross-test pack.
// Note: cross detection is var-state based, not ta.crossover — history references
// (`[1]` / ta.*) do not survive the pyne library boundary and would read as na.
library("AxisCrossKit")

export const color BULL = #34d399
export const color BEAR = #fb7185
export const color FLAT = #94a3b8

export enum CrossDir
    flat
    bull
    bear

/// true on the bar `a` crosses above `b`
export crossUp(float a, float b) =>
    var float pA = na
    var float pB = na
    up = not na(pA) and a > b and pA <= pB
    pA := a
    pB := b
    up

/// true on the bar `a` crosses below `b`
export crossDown(float a, float b) =>
    var float pA = na
    var float pB = na
    dn = not na(pA) and a < b and pA >= pB
    pA := a
    pB := b
    dn

/// Cross direction on this bar (CrossDir.flat when neither fired)
export crossDir(float a, float b) =>
    var float pA = na
    var float pB = na
    CrossDir d = CrossDir.flat
    if not na(pA)
        if a > b and pA <= pB
            d := CrossDir.bull
        else if a < b and pA >= pB
            d := CrossDir.bear
    pA := a
    pB := b
    d

/// Signed spread (a - b) as % of b; 0 when |b| is ~0
export spreadPct(float a, float b) =>
    math.abs(b) < 1e-12 ? 0.0 : (a - b) / b * 100.0

name: Cross Test · MA Ribbon
description: Indicator (overlay). ta.crossover/ta.crossunder of fast/slow EMA, green triangleup below bar, red triangledown above bar.
content:
//@version=6
// @description Cross-combo test: fast/slow EMA crossover + crossunder.
// triangleup (green) below the bar on bull cross, triangledown (red) above on bear cross.
indicator("Cross Test · MA Ribbon", shorttitle="XT MA", overlay=true)

fastLen = input.int(9, "Fast EMA", minval=1)
slowLen = input.int(21, "Slow EMA", minval=1)
src = input.source(close, "Source")

fast = ta.ema(src, fastLen)
slow = ta.ema(src, slowLen)

bull = ta.crossover(fast, slow)
bear = ta.crossunder(fast, slow)

plot(fast, "Fast EMA", color=#22d3ee, linewidth=2)
plot(slow, "Slow EMA", color=#fbbf24, linewidth=2)
plotshape(bull, "Cross Up", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, #34d399, size=size.small)
plotshape(bear, "Cross Down", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, #fb7185, size=size.small)

name: Cross Test · MACD Signal
description: Indicator (pane). MACD vs signal cross with histogram columns; green/red triangles at pane bottom/top.
content:
//@version=6
// @description Cross-combo test: MACD line vs signal line.
// triangleup (green) at the pane bottom on bull cross, triangledown (red) at the top on bear cross.
indicator("Cross Test · MACD Signal", shorttitle="XT MACD", overlay=false)

fastLen = input.int(12, "Fast EMA", minval=1)
slowLen = input.int(26, "Slow EMA", minval=1)
sigLen = input.int(9, "Signal", minval=1)
src = input.source(close, "Source")

[macdLine, signalLine, hist] = ta.macd(src, fastLen, slowLen, sigLen)

bull = ta.crossover(macdLine, signalLine)
bear = ta.crossunder(macdLine, signalLine)

plot(hist, "Histogram", style=plot.style_columns, color=hist >= 0 ? #34d399 : #fb7185)
plot(macdLine, "MACD", color=#6366f1, linewidth=2)
plot(signalLine, "Signal", color=#fbbf24)
hline(0, "Zero", color=#94a3b8)
plotshape(bull, "Cross Up", shape.triangleup, location.bottom, #34d399, size=size.small)
plotshape(bear, "Cross Down", shape.triangledown, location.top, #fb7185, size=size.small)

name: Cross Test · RSI Midline
description: Indicator (pane). RSI crossing a configurable midline (default 50); green/red triangles mark the cross bars.
content:
//@version=6
// @description Cross-combo test: RSI crossing the midline (default 50).
// triangleup (green) below on cross up through mid, triangledown (red) above on cross down.
indicator("Cross Test · RSI Midline", shorttitle="XT RSI", overlay=false)

len = input.int(14, "RSI Length", minval=2)
mid = input.float(50.0, "Midline", minval=1, maxval=99)
src = input.source(close, "Source")

r = ta.rsi(src, len)

bull = ta.crossover(r, mid)
bear = ta.crossunder(r, mid)

plot(r, "RSI", color=#6366f1, linewidth=2)
hline(mid, "Mid", color=#94a3b8, linestyle=hline.style_dotted)
hline(70, "Overbought", color=#fb7185, linestyle=hline.style_dashed)
hline(30, "Oversold", color=#34d399, linestyle=hline.style_dashed)
plotshape(bull, "Cross Up", shape.triangleup, location.bottom, #34d399, size=size.small)
plotshape(bear, "Cross Down", shape.triangledown, location.top, #fb7185, size=size.small)

name: Cross Test · Price vs SMA
description: Indicator (overlay). Source vs its own SMA cross (not a fast/slow pair); same marker grammar as the other XT tests.
content:
//@version=6
// @description Cross-combo test: raw source crossing its own SMA (not fast/slow pair).
// Same marker grammar as the other XT entries so all crosses read identically on chart.
indicator("Cross Test · Price vs SMA", shorttitle="XT Px/SMA", overlay=true)

len = input.int(50, "SMA Length", minval=2)
src = input.source(close, "Source")

basis = ta.sma(src, len)

bull = ta.crossover(src, basis)
bear = ta.crossunder(src, basis)

plot(basis, "SMA", color=#fbbf24, linewidth=2)
plotshape(bull, "Cross Up", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, #34d399, size=size.small)
plotshape(bear, "Cross Down", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, #fb7185, size=size.small)

name: Cross Test · Kit Consumer
description: Indicator (overlay). Import consumer for user/AxisCrossKit/1 — proves the library import path end to end. Publish AxisCrossKit first (namespace defaults to `user`).
content:
//@version=6
// @description Import-proof consumer for AxisCrossKit.
// 1) Import this pack, 2) open AxisCrossKit and press "Publish library",
// 3) make sure the import below matches the published namespace (default `user`).
import user/AxisCrossKit/1 as xkit

indicator("Cross Test · Kit Consumer", shorttitle="XT Kit", overlay=true)

fastLen = input.int(9, "Fast EMA", minval=1)
slowLen = input.int(21, "Slow EMA", minval=1)
src = input.source(close, "Source")

fast = ta.ema(src, fastLen)
slow = ta.ema(src, slowLen)

bull = xkit.crossUp(fast, slow)
bear = xkit.crossDown(fast, slow)
spread = xkit.spreadPct(fast, slow)

plot(fast, "Fast EMA", color=#22d3ee, linewidth=2)
plot(slow, "Slow EMA", color=#fbbf24, linewidth=2)
plot(spread, "Spread %", display=display.data_window)
plotshape(bull, "Kit Bull", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, xkit.BULL, size=size.small)
plotshape(bear, "Kit Bear", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, xkit.BEAR, size=size.small)

name: Cross Test · MA Strategy
description: Strategy (overlay). Same fast/slow EMA cross as the MA indicator, but fires long/flat orders; triangles stay on chart for visual diff vs the indicator.
content:
//@version=6
// @description Cross-combo test strategy: fast/slow EMA cross, long-only.
// Same marker grammar as the indicators; also proves strategy() + plotshape + orders in one pass.
strategy("Cross Test · MA Strategy", shorttitle="XT MA Strat", overlay=true,
     initial_capital=100000, default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity,
     default_qty_value=10, commission_type=strategy.commission.percent, commission_value=0.05)

fastLen = input.int(9, "Fast EMA", minval=1)
slowLen = input.int(21, "Slow EMA", minval=1)
src = input.source(close, "Source")

fast = ta.ema(src, fastLen)
slow = ta.ema(src, slowLen)

bull = ta.crossover(fast, slow)
bear = ta.crossunder(fast, slow)

if bull
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
if bear
    strategy.close("Long")

plot(fast, "Fast EMA", color=#22d3ee, linewidth=2)
plot(slow, "Slow EMA", color=#fbbf24, linewidth=2)
plotshape(bull, "Cross Up", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, #34d399, size=size.small)
plotshape(bear, "Cross Down", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, #fb7185, size=size.small)
